title: Why Hot Water Can Freeze Before Cold Water
description:
The Mpemba effect is one of the most counterintuitive observations in physics: under certain conditions, hot water freezes faster than cold water.

Evaporative mass loss, stronger convection currents, and dissolved gas differences all contribute. First documented by Erasto Mpemba in 1963, the paradox still challenges physicists today.
